# Corpus Fixture Request

## Fixture class

Describe the PDF behaviour, standard, malformed input or compatibility case.

## Claim supported

Which read, render, convert, redact, preserve or repair claim would this fixture support?

## Source and rights

Only submit fixtures that can be redistributed or synthetic fixtures that can be generated in-repo.
